title: Should CLI answers still be written into the decision index?
context: The one-click design finds earlier answers by reading the resolved folder, and every index lookup deliberately skips CLI answers. So nothing reads what this part writes. Review also proved a real regression: backfill lets automatic checks reuse store-shape answers after a damaged merge, with the ratchet approving a second kind and the spec-change guard skipping a pause. It also adds a one-off diff of about 144 entries, and a revert or an older teammate version can read those entries and skip a spec-change pause.

options.label: Drop it: keep today's index behaviour, and have the search show only the newest answer to the same question
